text_block_list.text:
Naturally, during summer camp,
you're free to do whatever you want outside of training hours.
Among the Umamusume, some even planned big events unique to summer.

text_block_list.name: Helios & Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayyy☆ And with that, summer fest vroooom♪
Everyone in casual clothes, whooooosh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see... So the five of us
are going to host a music festival, is that it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If it's on a small scale, it should be possible.
It might be more meaningful than simply idling around.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if you're doing it, I can help out too.
Just keep me behind the scenes, though.
I'm not built for the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh! That's right! Everyone has things they're good and bad at!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: So, when you say do it... what are we doing?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Were you even listening!?

It seems Twin Turbo and her four friends decided to
hold a music festival in a vacant lot by the sea.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uh... so, dear local elders.
Today, I was hoping to discuss whether we might borrow a little bit of your land...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We need a few more setup volunteers.
Let's reassign some from the venue crowd control staff.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone, listen up!
The Umamusume Summer Festival is happening tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—I'll do it. Tomorrow, I'm gonna totally
rock the house on the turntables!

Everyone gave their all to fulfill their respective rolesâ
and the morning of the big day arrived. As for Twin Turbo...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Guess what?
Turbo's gonna be an MC!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: So, what's an MC?
choice_data_list: In other words, you're the MC, right?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I see! Heh-heh, everyone was saying
"Turbo's a natural MC!"
Momentum is everything at a festival. Twin Turbo, naturally brimming with energy and having conquered her timidness, is more suited than anyone to hype up the crowd.

And so the main event began. Twin Turbo
bounded energetically onto the stage—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready?!
Everyone, are you reeeady?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: People in the back, can you see Turbo!?
(Silence...)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Wait, can you not see it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Your momentum is impeccable, but it seems you're a bit lacking in height.

It really is hard to see from here.
I quickly rushed over to Twin Turbo
to figure out a solution.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh.
Trainerrr, do somethinggg!

Twin Turbo's role was just a brief greeting.
After that, all she had to do was hand it over to DJ Helios.
"In that case, having the audience see her face for just a short moment was enough. If so, then the strategy is—"
choice_data_list: Carry in a platform and step up on it

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Carry a platform over and stand on it? Ah, good point!
We aren't singing or dancing today,
so that'll totally work.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Alright, gotta carry this and... Heave... ho...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
How's this, everyone? Can you see Turbo's face now~?
All right, here we gooo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"DJ Helioooos!
Passing the batooon!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha☆ Turbo's on the case!!
Hey hey, y'aaaaall♪
Are your vibes hyped through the roooof?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Beat it to my beat★
Vivid, Babbitt,
Everybody Uoooo!!"
(UOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Phew, Trainer!
Thanks to you, Turbo totally nailed it!

Twin Turbo fetched and put away the step stool all by herself,
looking quite satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Just jumping over and over? Ooooh,
that sounds like a challenge to Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It sounds tough, but I'm getting kinda fired up!
Turbo will do it! I'll show you I can!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Hey hey, can everyone see me～?!
Alright, let's get this festival started!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"DJ Helioooos!
Passing the batooon!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha☆ Turbo's on the case!!
Hey hey, y'aaaaall♪
Are your vibes hyped through the roooof?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Beat it to my beat★
Vivid, Babbitt,
Everybody Uoooo!!"
(UOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Phew, Trainer!
Turbo bounced and hopped around
like super crazy, you know!

Twin Turbo kept jumping with all her might,
fulfilling her role to the end.
And so, the handmade summer festival ended in massive success—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Man, we did it! We totally pulled it off!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was a great success.
Even with no time for a rehearsal and a few troubles along the way...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly impressed by everyone's agility and adaptability.
And by your support as well, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fu~!! Sweated like ten billion years' worth of sweat, ya know?
But the whole venue was totally hyped upâ

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Helios-san. Want some juice?
Man, you're amazing. I can't believe you can
do so much even without being a pro.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature! Turbo wants juice too!
Juice, juice!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Alright, alright, does anyone else want one~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall too~. Boy, that really got things going!
Mambo, Sunfish mambo~! Festival mambo~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Nature. Give me one too!

The lively celebration party went on and on.
And eventually, the night grew late—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hey... You might laugh
if I say something like this, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Races are great, but these kinds of festivities
are awesome too. I'd love to do this with everyone again.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm, Turbo wants to do it too! With even more full-power!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: You're right... Doing events together strengthens our bonds, after all.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe it won't happen until next year or the year after.
But hey, I'm sure there'll be another chance♪"
We all gazed up at the starry sky... Eventually, the group dispersed, leaving just Twin Turbo and me.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thanks for your help today.
Make sure you help Turbo next time I do something too!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Someone...? There's nobody else here
besides Turbo and the others, you know.

I felt like someone else was mixed in among the usual members.
Though it might just be my imagination.
And so, surrounded by all her friends... she spent a delightful summer moment.
